facts.fact: The Ministry of National Education press release says AI is integrated into State Exam grading at the National Grading Center in Kinshasa (inaugurated 10 April 2025) and at the Lubumbashi branch, which is operational and equipped to process more than 100,000 answer sheets, with Mbuji-Mayi as a second pilot centre.
facts.system: National Grading Center (State Exam grading with AI software)

systems.owner: Ministry of National Education and New Citizenship (MINEDU-NC)
systems.tiers: Kinshasa; Lubumbashi and Mbuji-Mayi pilot centres
